nodes.label: CyberAlchemy v2
nodes.meaning: The product whose capabilities help people and agents turn meaning into governed, evidence-bearing systems.

nodes.label: CyberAlchemy Product Thesis
nodes.meaning: The owner-held proposition that CyberAlchemy should preserve shared meaning, human agency, ergonomics, ownership, evidence, and honest incompleteness across the human-machine work loop.

nodes.label: Registry Context Project
nodes.meaning: The durable coordination boundary for building and evaluating Registry Context.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context Project owner

nodes.label: Registry Context First Vertical Goal
nodes.meaning: Prove one small Context-first, deterministic, read-only Registry Context vertical.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner

nodes.label: Context
nodes.meaning: The canonical CAV2-D66 frame for why information is needed, who will use it, and which Product, Project, Goal, subjects, Bounded Context references, and source policies apply.

nodes.label: Registry Context First Vertical Goal Context
nodes.meaning: The CAV2-D66 Goal Context that frames construction and evaluation of the Registry Context Project's first vertical.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context Project owner

nodes.label: Registry Context
nodes.meaning: A CAV2-D66 Context backed by registered exact selections and a read-only resolver.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Context product owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner

nodes.label: Resolve Registry Context
nodes.meaning: Resolve a named registered Context into a deterministic immutable View or fail closed.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner

nodes.label: Registry Context Request
nodes.meaning: A consumer request naming one Context, its expected digest, intended use, and registered selections.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner

nodes.label: Registry Context View
nodes.meaning: An immutable digest-bound materialization of one Context for one request.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner

nodes.label: Registry Context Integrity
nodes.meaning: Block unknown Contexts, Context drift, unknown selections, selection drift, path input, and authority escalation.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner plus affected source owners

nodes.label: Registry Context Resolver
nodes.meaning: The local deterministic read-only implementation of Resolve Registry Context.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner

nodes.label: Registry Context DomainSpec Project
nodes.meaning: The DomainSpec v2 machine source for the first resolver vertical under an explicit development-only profile.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Registry Context runtime owner

nodes.label: Registry Context v1 Compatibility Package
nodes.meaning: The byte-preserved former broad Define-oriented candidate retained for evidence and explicit migration.
